title: chronus.history.v1
description: Response of GET /api/v1/chronus/history: recent telemetry messages from the gateway's history ring, oldest first. When more messages match than 'limit' allows, the newest are returned and 'truncated' is true.

start.description: Lower time bound applied (ms since the Unix epoch), or null.

end.description: Upper time bound applied (ms since the Unix epoch), or null.

truncated.description: True when older matching messages were left out.

capacity.description: How many messages the gateway keeps (history.capacity).
